name: mfp_observation
title: Report an observation
description: Report something you noticed that matters beyond your current step, such as a flaky test, a bug or a risk, citing what it rests on. Call this when you notice it, not at the end of the task.

inputSchema.description: Something the model noticed, and what it rests on.

category.description: What kind of thing was noticed. Open in the core; a profile may close it. A lowercase token: letters, digits and inner hyphens, e.g. `request-changes`. It must match the regular expression `^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`.

summary.description: Text a reader is meant to read: at least one non-space character.

symbol.description: A symbol within the file, e.g. a function or class name.

anyOf.description: A git object id: 40 lowercase hex digits (SHA-1) or 64 (SHA-256). It must match the regular expression `^(?:[0-9a-f]{40}|[0-9a-f]{64})$`.

commit.description: The commit the anchor was read at. Absent means the commit the driver is working against.

anyOf.description: A code location the claim rests on.

ref.description:
An identifier the driver gave the model: a message, a tool call, an earlier
MFP message or a decision. A model never invents one.

anyOf.description: A message in the conversation, by the identifier the driver gave it.

ref.description:
An identifier the driver gave the model: a message, a tool call, an earlier
MFP message or a decision. A model never invents one.

anyOf.description: The result of a tool call, by the call's identifier.

ref.description:
An identifier the driver gave the model: a message, a tool call, an earlier
MFP message or a decision. A model never invents one.

anyOf.description: An earlier MFP message, by the identifier its receiver gave it.

cites.description: A citation list that must not be empty.

confidence.description: The model's own confidence in this report. An opinion about an opinion: it never carries weight.

ref.description: The identifier the receiver gave this report. Cite it later as {kind: "record", ref}.
